title: Agreement of Completed and Local Assignments
statement: Let $n$, a clause width parameter $w$, and a finite CNF formula on $n$ variables be given, and let $x$ be a sign assignment to its variables. For any clause in the Tseitin chain formed from a chosen clause of the formula and its auxiliary literals, and any literal in that clause, the completed assignment agrees with the local assignment for that chosen clause at the literal’s coordinate.
hypotheses_covered: A CNF formula on n variables
A sign assignment to the original variables
A valid clause index in the formula
A clause belonging to the Tseitin chain for that indexed clause
A literal belonging to that clause
